name: Non-linear Edge Function
description: Replaces the global vertex-neighborhood summation with a pairwise polynomial constraint evaluated on each edge: x^3 y + x y^3 = 10. Since x,y are restricted to {1,2}, this is uniquely satisfied if and only if x != y, perfectly preserving the 2-coloring requirement while completely removing the structural aggregations that models use to detect bipartiteness.
